title: Calibration set (triodian.raf.calibration.v1)
description: The AI risk appetite as parameters P1 to P11. The AI Risk Appetite app issues it when the CRO agrees the working appetite, and again when the board approves it; AI Use Assessment measures each AI arrangement against it. Written by risk_appetite public/app.js calibrationSet(); read by use-assessment public/aua.js validateCalibration(). A parameter the engagement has not set falls back to the framework default and is named in fellBackIds.

schema.description: Format and version of this file

privilegeMarking.description: The privilege marking the engagement carries, repeated on every output

status.description: default: nothing agreed yet, framework defaults apply; working: agreed by the CRO; approved: approved by the board

version.description: Calibration version; 0 before anything is agreed

statusMark.description: The status in words, as it appears on every output

date.description: The date the status was reached: the approval date if approved, otherwise the date agreed

agreedBy.description: Who agreed the working appetite (the CRO)

agreedOn.description: Date the working appetite was agreed (YYYY-MM-DD)

approvedBy.description: Who approved the appetite (the board or its committee)

minuteRef.description: Reference of the board minute that approved it

generated.description: When the file was generated (ISO 8601 date and time)

fellBackToDefault.description: Each parameter that fell back to the framework default, in words, e.g. 'P9: 1 of 1 cells default'

fellBackIds.description: The parameters that fell back to the framework default

defaults.description: The framework default for each parameter named in fellBackIds, keyed by parameter

parameters.description: The appetite, parameter by parameter (AI Risk Appetite Framework)

P1.description: Authority ceiling: for each function (by name), the highest authority tier AI may have in each location (own, provider, platform), with any condition; null where none is set

P2.description: Consequence thresholds in the entity's own terms, keyed by level and label (e.g. 'C4 Policyholder harm'), or 'generic' for the framework's wording

P3.description: Expected evidence rung for each authority tier (A1 to A6) and consequence level (C1 to C5)

P4.description: Gap priority for each evidence gap (g1: 1 rung, g2: 2 rungs, g3: 3 or more) and consequence band (b12: C1 or C2, b3: C3, b45: C4 or C5)

P5.description: For each priority, the time limit to close a gap and the interim position while it is open

timeLimit.description: Time limit to close the gap

interim.description: Interim position while it is open

P6.description: For each consequence band, how much may be not known, and how long an F4 finding may stay open

f4.description: How long an F4 finding may stay open

P7.description: For each consequence band, the lowest confidence accepted in an evidence level

P8.description: Locations: for each jurisdiction, whether a provider established there, and AI that runs there, is accepted

P9.description: Concentration limit: the highest share, in per cent, of critical operations that may depend on one platform or AI provider

P10.description: Triggers: what is reported, against which measure and threshold, how fast and to whom

measure.description: The measure it is read from

P11.description: Review: the events that reopen the appetite, and the regular interval

issued.description: A calibration set as the AI Risk Appetite app serves it at GET /api/calibration-set (risk_appetite lib/core/api.js issuedCalibration()) and inside the board view: the latest approved version, or the working version if none is approved

laterVersion.description: A later version the CRO has agreed but the board has not yet approved: named, not served
